title: Syracuse Meets EPA Lead Standard for the 4th Consecutive Period
summary: Syracuse Department of Water achieved EPA lead drinking water standards for the fourth consecutive reporting period (H1 2026), with 90th percentile results at 6 ppb versus 15 ppb action level. The department launched a Lead Pipe Construction Dashboard providing real-time public transparency on service line replacement work citywide, demonstrating infrastructure modernization and data-driven compliance monitoring.

entity_refs.name: New York State Department of Health

political_signal.description: Public demonstration of sustained EPA compliance achievement (4th consecutive period) and proactive infrastructure modernization via public-facing transparency tool signals administrative commitment to environmental health and public accountability.
